environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer. The /tmp directory is a shared EBS volume mounted across multiple container tasks in the same ECS service. No authentication middleware is configured on the ALB or application layer. The endpoint is publicly accessible via the ALB DNS name on port 443. Multiple worker processes share the /tmp/processing directory. OS is Amazon Linux 2023 with default umask 0022.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate with shared /tmp EFS mount
config.network: Public ALB, no WAF, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
config.filesystem: /tmp mounted as EFS with uid=1000, world-readable
config.concurrency: 4 tasks sharing same EFS mount point
